description: Diagnostic copy of portal2-intro4-relit-perf-v1 without the hard budget row, so frame_floor.py accepts render switches for cost attribution. Every run must pass '+exec render_budget_high' in --extra-arg to hold the pinned High settings, and no result here is acceptance evidence: the budget row's own workload owns that. The short scenario name 'r' keeps the launch under the Linux 512-byte argv limit (tier0/vcrmode_posix.cpp's MAX_LINUX_CMDLINE) once the diagnostic arguments are added.
